gloss: orally; verbally; by word of mouth

definitions.gloss: orally; verbally; by word of mouth
definitions.explanation: Doing something through spoken words rather than in writing. Used to specify that communication, instructions, or agreements are made verbally. 口頭 alone is a noun meaning "oral/verbal."

examples.japanese: {口頭|こうとう}で⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口頭|こうとう}で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{書面|しょめん}→書面：13023_shomen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧べきだ。
examples.english: Contracts should be made in writing, not verbally.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口頭|こうとう}で⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧や⟦{強|つよ}み→強み：12499_tsuyomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In an interview, you need to convey your experience and strengths verbally.
